title: Reasoning in Fewer Tokens: Concept-Normalized Multilingual Scratchpads and Reversible Model-Adaptive Reasoning Codes
abstract: arXiv:2611.27326v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-thought prompting significantly improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) but incurs high inference costs due to lengthy autoregressive decoding. While previous efficiency approaches reduce costs by discarding tokens or utilizing continuous latent representations, these lossy methods fundamentally sacrifice interpretability and auditability. In this work, we introduce a novel compression framework for intermediate reasoning. We apply Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) to reasoning corpora to learn a compressed vocabulary of Private Use Area (PUA) tokens, each representing frequent semantic spans. After expanding the LLM's vocabulary, we fine-tune the model via strictly 1:1, our method is lossless. We evaluate our approach on Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, and Qwen2.5-32B across four diverse benchmarks. Our method reduces total generated tokens by 14.7% on average with reasoning trace lengths dropping by up to 27.1%

translated_title: 用更少词元进行推理：概念归一化的多语言草稿纸与可逆的模型自适应推理编码
translated_abstract: 思维链提示显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但由于自回归解码过程冗长，带来了高昂的推理成本。以往的效率优化方法通过丢弃词元或使用连续的潜在表示来降低成本，然而这些有损方法从根本上牺牲了可解释性和可审计性。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的中间推理压缩框架。我们对推理语料应用字节对编码（BPE）来学习一个由私有使用区（PUA）词元组成的压缩词表，其中每个词元代表频繁出现的语义片段。在扩展LLM词表后，我们通过严格的一对一映射对模型进行微调，因此我们的方法是无损的。我们在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-14B和Qwen2.5-32B上，跨越四个不同的基准测试对该方法进行了评估。结果表明，我们的方法平均减少了14.7%的生成词元总数，推理轨迹长度最多减少27.1%。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无损的中间推理压缩框架，通过BPE学习由PUA词元构成的压缩词表并扩展LLM词表后微调模型，在保持可解释性和可审计性的同时，平均减少14.7%的生成词元，推理轨迹长度最多缩短27.1%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a lossless compression framework for intermediate reasoning that applies BPE to learn a compressed vocabulary of PUA tokens and fine-tunes LLMs with the expanded vocabulary, reducing total generated tokens by 14.7% on average and reasoning trace lengths by up to 27.1% while preserving interpretability and auditability.
